subject: Discovery closeout — security qualification, retention & pen-test artifacts
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alexandra Morris <alexandra.morris@pillarbank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery closeout — security qualification, retention & pen-test artifacts

Alexandra — thanks again for the time earlier. Per our call, I wanted to capture the key things we discussed and the concrete next steps so we have alignment on scope and timeline. I’ve pasted a very short summary below and attached the recording and our internal quick notes.

Recap / customer goals (what you told us)
- Audit readiness: PillarBank expects an external audit window in Q3, wants vendors to provide SOC 2 evidence and clear artifact mapping.
- Audit logs & retention: primary ask is 12 months of immutable audit logs for admin activity and data access, with the ability to export on demand.
- Data residency & DPA: Retail deposit data must remain in us-west and be covered by a DPA; controls must include KMS-backed encryption in transit and at rest.
- Pen test acceptance: PillarBank will accept third-party pen-test reports; they expect remediation timelines and a scannable artifact (report and raw scan files).

Open questions we agreed to resolve
1) Exact list of SOC 2 artifacts you require (controls mapping vs. our standard evidence pack) — Alexandra to confirm.
2) Retention exceptions policy: are there any regulatory holds >12 months?
3) Confirmation of required log fields (user id, IP, action, resource id, trace id) — you said you’ll share a sample format.
4) DocuSign flow for DPA / MPA: who on your side signs?

Next steps & owners
- Alexandra: share SOC 2 evidence scope and sample audit-logging format by 2027-04-25 (you indicated security@pillarbank will send).
- PillarBank Security Team: share the latest pen-test report or pointer to the results archive.
- Neha (CC): I’m handing intake/artifact mapping to Neha — she’ll align our evidence pack with your control list and surface gaps.
- Karthik (CC): will validate retention capabilities and provide a short config plan for 12-month immutable logs and export.
- Marissa: schedule a 30-minute follow-up for next Wednesday to review artifacts and go/no-go for the pilot.

Attachments: call recording, internal summary.

Plain next meeting: proposed Wed, Apr 28 10:00am PT — I’ll send an invite once we confirm.

Thanks again — we’ll be ready to map artifacts once we get the list from security@pillarbank.

—
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0133

Marissa — forwarding Alex’s recap into Security channel. Karthik, can you take the retention + export feasibility and confirm the plan below so I can map to our evidence pack?

Key asks for you:
- Confirm we can provide 12 months of immutable admin and access logs per resource (yes/no) and the config to enable that.
- Provide a short list of the fields we will surface in the export (user_id, ip_address, action, resource_id, trace_id, timestamp). If any are missing, call it out.
- Confirm whether we can produce a time-bound export (zip with JSON lines) for a legal hold.

I’ve included the original message for context below.

Subject: Re: Discovery closeout — security qualification, retention & pen-test artifacts

Marissa / Neha — thanks for the detailed recap. Agree with the summary; a few items answered below and I’ve attached what we can share today.

Quick answers
- SOC 2 artifacts: we need the standard Type II evidence (control mappings, system description, SOC 2 report summary). We can accept your standard evidence bundle if you provide a mapping document to our control ids (we will send control ids in a follow-up).
- Retention: 12 months is our baseline. We have two teams that may need longer holds for investigations, but they will request exceptions case-by-case; for now, assume 12 months.
- Audit fields: the sample format is attached (CSV with headers). Please confirm that trace_id is available in logs.
- Pen-test: attached is the executive pen-test summary plus raw scan output (redacted). We will not share the full vendor report until contract is in place, but this should be sufficient for qualification.

Attachments from PillarBank: [PillarBank_Security_Summary.pdf] (PDF, exec summary)
[PillarBank_PenTest_Scans.zip] (zip, redacted scan output)
[audit-log-sample.csv] (CSV sample)

Timeline & next actions
- Security will send control ids by Tue, Apr 27.
- We can get you the SOC 2 report extract after an NDA/DPA (we typically require a DPA + basic sitting-of-data agreement).
- Proposed follow-up: Wed, Apr 28 at 10:00am PT to review artifacts and confirm pilot scope.

If you need anything earlier, ping security@pillarbank.com and cc me.

Best,
Alexandra Morris
Sr. Director, Third-Party Risk | PillarBank
